senses.en: The lowest part of something.
The part of your body that you sit on.
In the lowest position.

ex.en: My keys were at the bottom of my bag.
ex.zh: 我的钥匙在包的最底下。

ex.en: Waste often collects at the bottom of rivers, damaging habitats and threatening aquatic life.
ex.zh: 废弃物经常堆积在河底，破坏栖息地并威胁水生生物。

col: from top to bottom｜从上到下
tip: 在某物底部用at the bottom of。

senses.en: A curved weapon with a string used to shoot arrows.
A knot with two loops and two loose ends.
To bend your head or body forward, often showing respect.

ex.en: She tied a neat bow around the gift box.
ex.zh: 她在礼盒上系了一个整齐的蝴蝶结。

ex.en: In some cultures, people bow when greeting others, while elsewhere a handshake is more common.
ex.zh: 在一些文化中，人们见面时会鞠躬，而在其他地方，握手更常见。

tip: 弓、蝴蝶结读/bəʊ/；鞠躬、船头读/baʊ/。

senses.en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids
to roll a bowling ball or deliver a cricket ball

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Serving meals in smaller bowls may help people control portions and reduce unnecessary food waste.
ex.zh: 用较小的碗盛饭可能有助于人们控制食量，减少不必要的食物浪费。

tip: a bowl of表示“一碗”；bowling指保龄球运动。

senses.en: a container with firm sides, often with a lid
to put something into a box
to compete in a sport using punches and protective gloves

ex.en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
ex.zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。

ex.en: Retailers can reduce packaging waste by choosing a box that closely matches the size of each product.
ex.zh: 零售商可以选择与每件商品大小相近的箱子，以减少包装浪费。

col: a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力
tip: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。

senses.en: a male child or young male person

ex.en: The boy carefully carried his puppy across the puddle.
ex.zh: 那个男孩小心地抱着小狗跨过水坑。

ex.en: Every boy and girl should have equal access to education, regardless of their family's income.
ex.zh: 无论家庭收入如何，每个男孩和女孩都应享有平等的受教育机会。

col: a teenage boy｜十几岁的男孩
tip: 通常指未成年男性；称成年男性为boy可能不礼貌。

senses.en: a woody part growing from a tree's trunk
a local office or division of a larger organization or subject
to divide into separate routes or parts

ex.en: A small bird landed on the lowest branch.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟落在了最低的树枝上。

ex.en: Opening a local branch allows banks to provide essential services to communities with limited internet access.
ex.zh: 开设当地分行能让银行为互联网接入有限的社区提供必要服务。

col: a branch of science｜科学的一个分支
tip: branch既指树枝，也指机构或学科的分支。

senses.en: Willing to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.
To face something dangerous or unpleasant with courage.

ex.en: You were brave to speak in front of everyone.
ex.zh: 你敢在大家面前发言，真勇敢。

ex.en: It takes brave leadership to introduce necessary environmental reforms when powerful groups strongly oppose them.
ex.zh: 当强势群体激烈反对时，推行必要的环境改革需要勇敢的领导力。

col: brave enough to｜有足够勇气做
tip: brave并非毫不害怕，而是害怕仍敢面对。

senses.en: a food made from flour and water, usually baked

ex.en: Fresh bread was cooling beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 刚出炉的面包放在厨房窗边晾凉。

ex.en: Choosing wholegrain bread instead of refined varieties can increase fibre intake and support a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 选择全谷物面包而非精制面包，可以增加膳食纤维摄入，有助于均衡饮食。

col: a loaf of bread｜一条面包
a slice of bread｜一片面包
tip: bread通常不可数；一片用a slice of bread。

senses.en: To separate into pieces or damage something so it stops working.
A short period when an activity stops.
To fail to obey a rule or keep a promise.

ex.en: Be careful not to break that glass bowl.
ex.zh: 小心别打碎那个玻璃碗。

ex.en: Regular breaks during study sessions may improve concentration and help students retain new information.
ex.zh: 学习期间定时休息可能有助于提高注意力，并帮助学生记住新知识。

tip: 动词变化为break—broke—broken；休息用take a break。

senses.en: the meal you eat at the start of the day

ex.en: I usually have breakfast before taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我通常吃完早餐再去坐公交车。

ex.en: Schools that provide a healthy breakfast may help students concentrate better during morning lessons.
ex.zh: 提供健康早餐的学校可能有助于学生在上午的课堂上更加专注。

col: a balanced breakfast｜营养均衡的早餐
tip: 泛指吃早餐用have breakfast，不加冠词。

senses.en: air moving into or out of your lungs
one act of taking air into your lungs

ex.en: Her breath formed a cloud in the cold air.
ex.zh: 她呼出的气在冷空气中形成了一团白雾。

ex.en: Taking a slow, deep breath can help students manage anxiety before an important examination.
ex.zh: 缓慢地深呼吸一次，有助于学生缓解重要考试前的焦虑。

col: take a deep breath｜深吸一口气
out of breath｜上气不接下气
tip: breath是名词；breathe是动词，末尾读/ð/。

senses.en: A structure carrying people or vehicles over an obstacle.
To connect separated things or reduce differences between them.
A card game played by four people in two partnerships.

ex.en: We crossed the wooden bridge and entered the village.
ex.zh: 我们走过木桥，进了村子。

ex.en: Community language programmes can bridge cultural differences and help newcomers participate more fully in local life.
ex.zh: 社区语言项目可以弥合文化差异，帮助新来者更充分地参与当地生活。

tip: bridge the gap常指缩小群体或事物间的差距。

senses.en: giving much light or having a strong, clear colour
quick to learn and understand things
promising success or showing happiness

ex.en: Bright sunlight streamed through the kitchen window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，明亮的阳光从厨房窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Access to quality education can give young people a bright future regardless of their family background.
ex.zh: 无论家庭背景如何，获得优质教育都能让年轻人拥有光明的未来。

tip: 形容光线强用bright；形容房间暗用dim。

senses.en: The amount of light something gives off or reflects.
The quality of having strong, vivid colours.
The ability to understand and learn things quickly.

ex.en: I lowered the screen's brightness before watching a film.
ex.zh: 看电影前，我调低了屏幕亮度。

ex.en: Reducing the brightness of outdoor lighting at night can save energy and limit disruption to wildlife.
ex.zh: 夜间降低户外照明亮度可以节约能源，并减少对野生动物的干扰。

col: the brightness of colours｜色彩的鲜艳程度
tip: 不可数；屏幕的“亮度”用brightness，不用lightness。

senses.en: to carry someone or something to a place
to cause a situation, feeling, or result

ex.en: Please bring a warm coat when you visit.
ex.zh: 你来时请带一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Improved public transport can bring significant benefits to residents who cannot afford their own cars.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通能为买不起私家车的居民带来显著益处。

col: bring someone something｜给某人带来某物
tip: bring强调带到说话者或指定地点；过去式brought。

senses.en: Relating to the United Kingdom, its people, or their culture.
The people of the United Kingdom, considered collectively.

ex.en: My British neighbour invited us over for tea.
ex.zh: 我的英国邻居邀请我们过去喝茶。

ex.en: British universities attract international students through their research strengths and the wide range of courses they offer.
ex.zh: 英国大学凭借科研实力和丰富的课程选择吸引国际学生。

tip: 英国人总称用the British；单个人用a Briton。

senses.en: Damaged by being split or separated into pieces.
Not working properly because of damage.
Spoken with difficulty and frequent pauses or errors.

ex.en: She carefully swept the broken glass into a dustpan.
ex.zh: 她小心地把碎玻璃扫进簸箕里。

ex.en: Repairing broken household appliances rather than replacing them can reduce waste and conserve valuable natural resources.
ex.zh: 维修损坏的家用电器而非更换它们，可以减少废弃物并节约宝贵的自然资源。

col: a broken promise｜未兑现的承诺
tip: 也是break的过去分词；过去式为broke。

senses.en: A brownish metal made mainly from copper and tin.
A medal awarded for finishing third in a competition.
Made of bronze, or having its reddish-brown color.

ex.en: The small statue is made of solid bronze.
ex.zh: 这尊小雕像是用实心青铜制成的。

ex.en: Ancient tools made from bronze reveal how advances in metalworking transformed agriculture and trade across early societies.
ex.zh: 古代青铜工具揭示了金属加工技术的进步如何改变早期社会的农业和贸易。

tip: bronze是青铜；brass是黄铜；copper是铜。

senses.en: A male who has one or both parents in common with you.

ex.en: My younger brother borrowed my bicycle this morning.
ex.zh: 我弟弟今天早上借用了我的自行车。

ex.en: Older brothers and sisters can support younger children's learning by reading with them regularly at home.
ex.zh: 哥哥姐姐可以通过经常在家陪弟弟妹妹阅读来帮助他们学习。

tip: brother不区分兄弟；用older或younger说明长幼。

senses.en: Having the colour of chocolate or dark wood.
The colour of chocolate or dark wood.
To become brown, or make food brown through cooking.

ex.en: A small brown dog was sleeping beside the door.
ex.zh: 一只棕色的小狗正在门边睡觉。

ex.en: During dry periods, grass often turns brown as plants conserve water and reduce their growth.
ex.zh: 在干旱时期，植物为了保存水分会减缓生长，草也常因此变成褐色。

tip: brown作动词常用于烹饪，指把食物煎或烤至褐色。

senses.en: a tool with bristles used for cleaning, painting or arranging hair
to clean, paint or arrange something using a brush
to touch something lightly while moving past it

ex.en: Use a soft brush to clean your muddy shoes.
ex.zh: 用软毛刷清理你沾满泥的鞋子。

ex.en: Children should learn to brush their teeth properly, as good habits can prevent many dental problems.
ex.zh: 儿童应学会正确刷牙，因为良好的习惯可以预防许多牙齿问题。

tip: brush against表示轻擦；brush up on表示温习。

senses.en: A plan for spending money, or the amount available.
To plan how much money to spend on particular things.
Low in price compared with similar products or services.

ex.en: We have a small budget for our weekend trip.
ex.zh: 我们周末旅行的预算不多。

ex.en: Local governments should allocate a larger share of their budget to maintaining public transport systems.
ex.zh: 地方政府应将更大比例的预算用于维护公共交通系统。

col: on a tight budget｜预算紧张
budget for expenses｜为开支做预算
tip: budget for后接预计开支；on a budget指经费有限。

senses.en: to make structures or develop something over time
the size and shape of a person's body

ex.en: We built a small wooden shelter in the garden.
ex.zh: 我们在花园里搭了一个小木棚。

ex.en: Local authorities should build more affordable homes near public transport to support families on low incomes.
ex.zh: 地方政府应在公共交通设施附近建造更多经济适用住房，以帮助低收入家庭。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为built；体格可用build。

senses.en: a structure with walls and a roof
the activity of constructing houses or other structures

ex.en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
ex.zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。

ex.en: Improving insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and lower heating costs for residents.
ex.zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，降低居民的取暖费用。

tip: 指建筑物时可数，指建造活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: To produce flames, or destroy something with fire.
To damage skin or other material through heat.
An injury caused by heat, chemicals, or electricity.

ex.en: A small fire burned quietly in the fireplace.
ex.zh: 壁炉里，一小团火静静地燃烧着。

ex.en: Burning fossil fuels releases greenhouse gases, making cleaner energy sources essential for environmental protection.
ex.zh: 燃烧化石燃料会释放温室气体，因此清洁能源对环境保护至关重要。

col: burn fossil fuels｜燃烧化石燃料
tip: 过去式和过去分词可用burnt或burned。

senses.en: A woody plant with several branches growing near the ground.
Wild, uncultivated land, especially in Australia or Africa.

ex.en: A small bird was hiding in the rose bush.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟躲在玫瑰丛里。

ex.en: Planting native bushes in urban gardens can provide shelter and food for local wildlife.
ex.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地灌木，可以为当地野生动物提供庇护和食物。

tip: 灌木是可数名词；the bush可指澳洲等地的荒野。

senses.en: The activity of buying and selling goods or services.
An organisation that sells goods or services.
Matters that someone needs to deal with or is responsible for.

ex.en: Business is usually slow at the café on Mondays.
ex.zh: 这家咖啡馆周一的生意通常比较清淡。

ex.en: Small businesses often create local employment, but they may struggle to compete with larger companies.
ex.zh: 小企业通常能为当地创造就业机会，但可能难以与大公司竞争。

col: none of your business｜与你无关
tip: 指商业活动时不可数；指具体企业时可数。

senses.en: A man who works in business, especially managing a company.

ex.en: A local businessman opened a bakery near our school.
ex.zh: 一位当地商人在我们学校附近开了一家面包店。

ex.en: A successful businessman can support local development by investing in training and creating stable employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 成功的商人可以通过投资培训和创造稳定就业机会来支持当地发展。

tip: 复数为businessmen；不限定性别可用businessperson。

senses.en: Having many things to do or being actively occupied.
Full of people, traffic, or activity.
Already being used, especially a telephone line.

ex.en: I am busy making soup for dinner right now.
ex.zh: 我现在正忙着做晚餐要喝的汤。

ex.en: Busy urban roads can discourage cycling unless local authorities provide safe routes separated from motor traffic.
ex.zh: 繁忙的城市道路可能让人不愿骑车，除非地方政府提供与机动车流隔离的安全路线。

tip: 用busy doing或busy with，不用busy to do。

senses.en: a pale yellow fat made from cream, used in food
to spread butter on food

ex.en: She spread some butter on a slice of warm bread.
ex.zh: 她在一片温热的面包上抹了些黄油。

ex.en: Replacing some butter with unsaturated oils can help people reduce their overall intake of saturated fat.
ex.zh: 用不饱和油脂替代部分黄油，有助于减少饱和脂肪的总体摄入量。

col: a knob of butter｜一小块黄油
tip: butter是黄油，cream是奶油；作食品名通常不可数。

senses.en: An insect with broad, often colourful wings and a thin body.
A swimming stroke with both arms moving forward together above water.

ex.en: A yellow butterfly landed gently on my sleeve.
ex.zh: 一只黄色蝴蝶轻轻落在我的袖子上。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban gardens can support butterfly populations and contribute to greater local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市花园中种植本地花卉可以帮助维持蝴蝶种群，并提升当地的生物多样性。

tip: 复数为butterflies；蝶泳义通常不可数。

senses.en: A small control you press to operate something
A small object that fastens clothing through a hole
Fasten clothing using buttons

ex.en: Press the green button to start the washing machine.
ex.zh: 按绿色按钮启动洗衣机。

ex.en: Emergency buttons on public transport allow passengers to alert staff quickly when assistance is needed.
ex.zh: 公共交通工具上的紧急按钮让乘客能够在需要帮助时迅速通知工作人员。

col: button up a coat｜扣好外套
sew on a button｜缝上纽扣
tip: button up指扣好纽扣；拉链用zip，不用button。

senses.en: to obtain something by paying money for it
to believe an explanation or accept an idea

senses.zh: 买到的东西；合算的购买
senses.en: something bought, especially something offering good value

ex.en: I need to buy some bread before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我需要在吃早饭前买些面包。

ex.en: Consumers can reduce packaging waste when they buy fresh produce from local markets.
ex.zh: 消费者在当地市场购买新鲜农产品时，可以减少包装废弃物。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为bought；不要写成buyed。

senses.en: Shows who or what performs an action in passive sentences.
Using a particular method or means.
No later than a particular time.

ex.en: This wooden bowl was made by my grandfather.
ex.zh: 这个木碗是我祖父做的。

ex.en: Urban air quality can be improved by expanding public transport and encouraging residents to cycle more often.
ex.zh: 扩大公共交通服务并鼓励居民更多骑车，可以改善城市空气质量。

col: by the end of｜不迟于……结束时
tip: by表示截止时间；until表示状态持续到某时。

senses.en: a vegetable with large leaves forming a firm round head

ex.en: She sliced the cabbage thinly and added it to soup.
ex.zh: 她把卷心菜切成细丝，放进汤里。

ex.en: Locally grown vegetables such as cabbage can support healthier diets while reducing the environmental impact of food transport.
ex.zh: 卷心菜等本地种植的蔬菜有助于改善饮食健康，同时减少食品运输对环境的影响。

col: a head of cabbage｜一颗卷心菜
tip: 整颗可数：a cabbage；作为食材通常不可数。

senses.en: a container with bars or wire for keeping animals inside
to put or keep an animal in a cage

ex.en: The rabbit's cage has fresh hay and clean water.
ex.zh: 兔笼里有新鲜的干草和干净的水。

ex.en: Animal welfare groups argue that small cages prevent birds from flying freely and expressing natural behaviour.
ex.zh: 动物福利组织认为，小笼子使鸟类无法自由飞翔和表现自然行为。

col: keep in a cage｜关在笼子里
tip: in a cage表示在笼中；caged birds指笼养鸟。

senses.en: A sweet food baked from flour, eggs, sugar, and fat.
To cover with a thick layer or form hard lumps.

ex.en: We shared a slice of lemon cake after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，我们分着吃了一片柠檬蛋糕。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by offering fresh fruit instead of cake at school celebrations.
ex.zh: 学校可以在校内庆祝活动中提供新鲜水果而非蛋糕，以鼓励更健康的饮食。

col: a slice of cake｜一片蛋糕
be caked in mud｜沾满厚厚的泥
tip: 整个蛋糕可数；泛指蛋糕这种食物时常不可数。

senses.en: A chart of dates or a schedule of events.
A system for dividing time into years, months, and days.

ex.en: I marked our camping weekend on the kitchen calendar.
ex.zh: 我在厨房的日历上标出了周末露营的日子。

ex.en: Schools should publish an annual calendar so families can plan holidays around important educational events.
ex.zh: 学校应公布年度日程表，方便家庭避开重要教学活动来安排假期。

tip: calendar year指一月至十二月，不等于学年。

senses.en: To telephone someone or shout to get their attention.
To give someone or something a particular name.
A telephone conversation or a public request for action.

ex.en: I'll call you when I get home tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚到家后我会给你打电话。

ex.en: Environmental groups call for stricter regulations to reduce plastic waste entering rivers and oceans.
ex.zh: 环保团体呼吁制定更严格的法规，减少流入河流和海洋的塑料垃圾。

col: call for action｜呼吁采取行动
call someone back｜给某人回电话
tip: call sb表示给某人打电话，不加to。

senses.en: Not worried or excited; without strong movement or disturbance.
To become less upset, or make someone feel more relaxed.
A peaceful state without worry, noise, or disturbance.

ex.en: She stayed calm when the lights suddenly went out.
ex.zh: 灯突然熄灭时，她依然保持镇静。

ex.en: A calm classroom atmosphere can help students concentrate and feel more confident about asking questions.
ex.zh: 平静的课堂氛围有助于学生集中注意力，也让他们更有信心提问。

tip: calm中的l不发音；calm down表示平静下来。

senses.en: A device used to take photographs or record moving images.

ex.en: She raised her camera to photograph the sleeping cat.
ex.zh: 她举起相机，给熟睡的猫拍照。

ex.en: Installing a camera at each entrance may improve security, but residents have raised concerns about privacy.
ex.zh: 在每个入口安装摄像头或许能提高安全性，但居民对隐私问题表示担忧。

tip: camera可指照相机或摄像机，具体看语境。

senses.en: A place where people stay temporarily, often in tents.
Stay outdoors temporarily in a tent or similar shelter.
A group sharing the same opinions or aims.

ex.en: We returned to camp before the rain started.
ex.zh: 我们在下雨前回到了营地。

ex.en: Schools can organise outdoor camps to help students develop independence and learn practical skills beyond the classroom.
ex.zh: 学校可以组织户外营地活动，帮助学生培养独立性并学习课堂之外的实用技能。

tip: go camping表示去露营；camp也可指观点相同的阵营。

senses.en: Used to express ability, permission, or possibility.
A metal container for food, drinks, or other substances.
To preserve food by sealing it in cans.

ex.en: I can carry both bags if you open the door.
ex.zh: 你要是把门打开，我就能把两个袋子都提进去。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet can help rural students benefit from a wider range of educational resources.
ex.zh: 稳定的互联网接入能帮助农村学生利用更丰富的教育资源。

tip: 作情态动词后接动词原形，第三人称不加s。

senses.en: a country in North America, north of the United States

ex.en: My cousin moved to Canada to study environmental science.
ex.zh: 我的表亲搬到加拿大去学习环境科学。

ex.en: Canada attracts international students through its universities, although living costs vary considerably between cities.
ex.zh: 加拿大的大学吸引着国际学生，不过各城市的生活成本差异很大。

col: study in Canada｜在加拿大学习
tip: 国名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

senses.en: relating to Canada, its people, or its culture
a person from Canada

ex.en: Our Canadian neighbour invited us over for dinner yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们的加拿大邻居昨天邀请我们去他家吃晚饭。

ex.en: Canadian cities face challenges in providing affordable housing while accommodating population growth and protecting green spaces.
ex.zh: 加拿大城市面临着提供可负担住房、容纳增长人口以及保护绿地的多重挑战。

tip: 国籍词首字母大写；名词复数为Canadians。

senses.en: To decide that something planned will not happen.
To balance an opposing effect so neither changes the result.

ex.en: We had to cancel our picnic because of heavy rain.
ex.zh: 由于下大雨，我们不得不取消野餐。

ex.en: Improved energy efficiency may cancel out some environmental benefits if it encourages people to consume more.
ex.zh: 如果能源效率提高促使人们增加消费，就可能抵消部分环境效益。

tip: 英式过去式cancelled，美式常用canceled；抵消用out。

senses.en: a sweet food made mainly from sugar

ex.en: She offered each guest a small piece of candy.
ex.zh: 她给每位客人递了一小块糖果。

ex.en: Limiting advertisements for candy aimed at children could help families develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 限制面向儿童的糖果广告，可以帮助家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: a piece of candy｜一块糖果
a candy bar｜一条巧克力糖
tip: 美式常用candy，英式常用sweets；一块用a piece of。

senses.en: a soft hat, often with a stiff front part
a cover fitted over the end or opening of something
to set a maximum amount or level for something

ex.en: He pulled on his cap before leaving for practice.
ex.zh: 他戴上帽子后出门去训练。

ex.en: Governments could cap annual rent increases to protect households from sudden rises in housing costs.
ex.zh: 政府可以限制年度租金涨幅，以保护家庭免受住房成本骤增的影响。

col: a cap on fees｜费用上限
tip: cap作动词指设上限；a cap on后接受限项目。

senses.en: the city where a country or region's government is based
money or assets used to start or operate a business
a letter in its large form

ex.en: We visited the capital and explored its busy markets.
ex.zh: 我们游览了首都，逛了那里热闹的市场。

ex.en: Small businesses often struggle to obtain enough capital to invest in new equipment and staff training.
ex.zh: 小企业往往难以筹集足够资金，用于购置新设备和培训员工。

tip: 表示资金时通常不可数；表示大写字母时可数。

senses.en: a road vehicle with wheels, usually carrying a few people
one of the separate sections of a train

ex.en: Our car is parked under the tree outside.
ex.zh: 我们的汽车停在外面的树下。

ex.en: Reducing private car use could improve urban air quality and make streets safer for pedestrians.
ex.zh: 减少私家车使用可以改善城市空气质量，让街道对行人更安全。

tip: by car不加冠词；in a car需要冠词。

senses.en: A small stiff rectangle used for payment, identification, or information.
A decorated card sent with a greeting or personal message.
One of a set of small rectangles used in games.

ex.en: I tapped my card to pay for the groceries.
ex.zh: 我刷卡支付了买食品杂货的钱。

ex.en: Providing every student with a library card encourages independent reading and improves access to educational resources.
ex.zh: 为每位学生办理借书证，有助于鼓励自主阅读，并改善教育资源的获取条件。

tip: play cards指打牌，cards用复数，前面不加冠词。

senses.en: Support and attention given to someone who needs help
To feel concern or consider something important
Attention given to avoiding mistakes or damage

ex.en: My grandmother receives excellent care at the local clinic.
ex.zh: 我奶奶在当地诊所得到很好的照料。

ex.en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to remain employed while ensuring that young children receive appropriate care.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的托育服务让更多家长能够继续工作，同时确保幼儿得到妥善照料。

tip: care about指在意；care for可指照料或喜欢。

senses.en: Not giving enough attention to avoid mistakes or damage.

ex.en: I was careless and left my keys in the door.
ex.zh: 我一时粗心，把钥匙留在了门上。

ex.en: Careless disposal of household waste can pollute local waterways and create serious risks for wildlife.
ex.zh: 随意丢弃生活垃圾会污染当地水道，并给野生动物带来严重风险。

col: a careless mistake｜粗心造成的错误
tip: careless是粗心的；carefree才是无忧无虑的。

senses.en: A long, usually orange root vegetable.
A reward offered to encourage someone to do something.

ex.en: She sliced a carrot and added it to the soup.
ex.zh: 她把一根胡萝卜切片，放进汤里。

ex.en: Governments can use tax reductions as a carrot to encourage businesses to invest in renewable energy.
ex.zh: 政府可以用减税作为激励，鼓励企业投资可再生能源。

tip: 比喻奖励或诱因；carrot and stick指奖惩并用。

senses.en: Hold or support something while moving it somewhere
Have something with you wherever you go
Contain and potentially pass on a disease or infection

ex.en: Could you carry this heavy bag upstairs for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这个沉重的袋子拿上楼吗？

ex.en: Reusable bottles allow commuters to carry drinking water without purchasing disposable plastic containers every day.
ex.zh: 可重复使用的水瓶让通勤者能随身带水，无须每天购买一次性塑料容器。

tip: carry强调携带或搬运；bring和take还体现方向。

senses.en: a film or programme made using animated drawings or images
a humorous drawing, often commenting on society or politics

ex.en: We watched a funny cartoon about a dancing penguin.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部关于跳舞企鹅的搞笑动画片。

ex.en: Political cartoons can communicate complex social criticism through simple images that appeal to a wide audience.
ex.zh: 政治漫画可以通过简单的图像传达复杂的社会批评，吸引广泛的受众。

tip: cartoon 可指动画片或单幅漫画；漫画书常用 comic。

senses.en: A particular situation or example, including an instance of illness.
A container that holds or protects something.
A legal matter or arguments supporting a particular position.

ex.en: Take an umbrella in case it rains later.
ex.zh: 带把伞吧，以防待会儿下雨。

ex.en: In many cases, investing in preventive healthcare is more cost-effective than treating diseases after they develop.
ex.zh: 在许多情况下，投资预防保健比在疾病出现后进行治疗更具成本效益。

col: in some cases｜在某些情况下
in case of emergency｜遇到紧急情况时
a strong case for｜支持某事的有力论据
tip: in case后接从句；in case of后接名词。

senses.en: Money in the form of coins and banknotes
Exchange a cheque for money

ex.en: I keep some cash in my wallet for emergencies.
ex.zh: 我在钱包里放了一些现金，以备急用。

ex.en: Although digital payments are increasingly common, many small businesses still prefer customers to pay in cash.
ex.zh: 尽管电子支付日益普及，许多小商家仍然更希望顾客用现金付款。

tip: cash作现金讲不可数；用现金付款是pay in cash。

senses.en: A small furry animal often kept as a pet.
An animal belonging to the same family as lions.

ex.en: Our cat sleeps in a sunny spot by the window.
ex.zh: 我们家的猫睡在窗边阳光照得到的地方。

ex.en: Keeping pet cats indoors can help protect native birds, particularly in areas with vulnerable wildlife populations.
ex.zh: 将宠物猫养在室内有助于保护本地鸟类，尤其是在野生动物种群脆弱的地区。

tip: big cats指狮、虎等大型猫科动物。

senses.en: something that makes an event or situation happen
make something happen, especially something unpleasant
an aim or principle that people support and work towards

ex.en: The plumber found the cause of the leak.
ex.zh: 水管工找到了漏水的原因。

ex.en: Heavy traffic is a major cause of air pollution in many rapidly growing urban areas.
ex.zh: 在许多快速发展的城市地区，繁忙的交通是空气污染的主要原因。

tip: 名词常接of；动词可用cause sb to do sth。

senses.en: A large natural hollow inside rock or under the ground.

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain inside a small cave.
ex.zh: 我们躲进一个小山洞里避雨。

ex.en: Ancient paintings found in a cave can reveal how early communities understood their surroundings.
ex.zh: 洞穴中发现的古代绘画可以揭示早期群体如何理解周围环境。

tip: cave指洞穴；动词短语cave in表示坍塌或屈服。

senses.en: To mark a special occasion by doing something enjoyable.
To praise someone or something publicly.

ex.en: We cooked a special dinner to celebrate her graduation.
ex.zh: 我们做了一顿特别的晚餐来庆祝她毕业。

ex.en: Community festivals celebrate local traditions while giving residents opportunities to strengthen relationships with their neighbours.
ex.zh: 社区节庆活动在弘扬当地传统的同时，也让居民有机会增进邻里关系。

col: celebrate an achievement｜庆祝一项成就
tip: 庆祝某事用celebrate；祝贺某人用congratulate。

senses.en: A special event held to mark a happy occasion.
The act of showing happiness about something special.

ex.en: We decorated the garden for our grandparents' anniversary celebration.
ex.zh: 我们为祖父母的结婚周年庆祝活动布置了花园。

ex.en: Community celebrations can strengthen social bonds by bringing together residents from different cultural backgrounds.
ex.zh: 社区庆祝活动能让不同文化背景的居民相聚，从而加强社会联系。

col: hold a celebration｜举办庆祝活动
tip: 指具体庆祝活动时可数；指庆祝行为时不可数。

senses.en: in or near the middle of a place
extremely important or essential to something

ex.en: Our apartment is central, so we walk to most places.
ex.zh: 我们的公寓位于市中心，因此去大多数地方都步行。

ex.en: Access to reliable information is central to helping citizens make informed decisions about public health.
ex.zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民就公共卫生作出明智决定至关重要。

tip: central to表示“对……至关重要”，介词用to。

senses.en: The middle point or area of something.
A place providing particular activities, services, or facilities.
Make something the main focus of attention or activity.

ex.en: We placed a vase in the centre of the table.
ex.zh: 我们在桌子中央摆了一个花瓶。

ex.en: A new community centre could provide affordable exercise facilities and meeting spaces for local residents.
ex.zh: 新的社区中心可以为当地居民提供价格实惠的健身设施和聚会场所。

tip: centre是英式拼写，美式写center；动词常接on。

senses.en: A period of one hundred years.

ex.en: This bridge was built more than a century ago.
ex.zh: 这座桥建于一个多世纪以前。

ex.en: Over the past century, improvements in sanitation have contributed significantly to longer life expectancy worldwide.
ex.zh: 过去一个世纪里，卫生条件的改善对全球预期寿命的延长作出了重大贡献。

col: over a century ago｜一个多世纪以前
the turn of the century｜世纪之交
tip: 世纪序数比年份前两位大一：如1901—2000为20世纪。

senses.en: A formal event marking an important occasion.
Formal behaviour required by tradition or social rules.

ex.en: We attended a small wedding ceremony by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们参加了湖边一场小型婚礼。

ex.en: A graduation ceremony allows students and families to celebrate educational achievements together as a community.
ex.zh: 毕业典礼让学生和家人齐聚一堂，共同庆祝学业成就。

tip: 指具体典礼时可数；without ceremony意为不拘礼节。

senses.en: Used to express that something is definitely true.
Used to agree politely to a request.

ex.en: This warm coat will certainly keep you comfortable outside.
ex.zh: 这件暖和的大衣肯定能让你在外面也舒舒服服的。

ex.en: Improved public transport would certainly benefit commuters, although its success would depend on reliable services and affordable fares.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通无疑会惠及通勤者，但成效取决于服务是否可靠、票价是否合理。

col: will certainly help｜肯定会有帮助
tip: 常置于实义动词前、be后；也可单独礼貌回应请求。

senses.en: a series of connected metal rings
connected shops, events, or other things forming a series
to fasten someone or something with a chain

ex.en: He secured his bicycle with a heavy metal chain.
ex.zh: 他用一条沉重的金属链锁好了自行车。

ex.en: Large supermarket chains can offer lower prices, but their expansion may threaten small independent shops.
ex.zh: 大型连锁超市可以提供更低的价格，但其扩张可能威胁独立小商店。

col: a chain of events｜一连串事件
chain a bicycle to a railing｜用链条把自行车锁在栏杆上
tip: a chain of后接复数名词，表示相连的一系列事物。

senses.en: a seat for one person, usually with a back
the person responsible for leading a meeting or committee
to lead a meeting and manage its discussion

ex.en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
ex.zh: 她把一把椅子拉到离窗户更近的地方。

ex.en: An independent expert should chair the meeting to ensure that all participants can contribute fairly.
ex.zh: 应由一位独立专家主持会议，确保所有参与者都能公平地发表意见。

tip: chair作动词直接接meeting，表示主持会议。

senses.en: A difficult task or situation that tests someone's abilities.
Question whether something is true, fair, or acceptable.
Invite someone to compete or test their abilities.

ex.en: Cooking dinner for twelve guests was quite a challenge.
ex.zh: 给十二位客人做晚饭真是个不小的挑战。

ex.en: Providing affordable housing remains a major challenge for cities experiencing rapid population growth and rising land prices.
ex.zh: 对于人口快速增长、地价不断上涨的城市而言，提供可负担住房仍是一项重大挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

senses.en: Difficult in a way that tests skills or determination.
Expressing doubt or inviting disagreement or competition.

ex.en: This challenging puzzle kept us busy all afternoon.
ex.zh: 这道有难度的谜题让我们忙了整整一下午。

ex.en: Providing affordable healthcare in remote communities remains challenging because trained medical staff and essential equipment are often scarce.
ex.zh: 由于受过培训的医护人员和必要设备往往短缺，在偏远社区提供可负担的医疗服务仍然困难。

tip: 形容任务有难度用challenging，不用challenged。

senses.en: a person or team that wins a competition
someone who strongly supports a cause or group
to actively support or defend a cause or person

ex.en: The new champion lifted her trophy with both hands.
ex.zh: 新冠军双手举起了奖杯。

ex.en: Local organisations can champion affordable housing by working with residents and presenting practical proposals to councils.
ex.zh: 地方组织可以与居民合作，向地方议会提交切实可行的提案，推动提供可负担住房。

col: a champion of equality｜平等的拥护者
champion a cause｜支持一项事业
tip: 作动词直接接宾语：champion a cause。

senses.en: An opportunity to do something.
The likelihood that something will happen.
Events happening without planning or a predictable cause.

ex.en: Can you give me another chance to explain?
ex.zh: 你能再给我一次解释的机会吗？

ex.en: Affordable training gives unemployed adults a chance to gain new skills and return to the workforce.
ex.zh: 费用可负担的培训让失业的成年人有机会掌握新技能，重返职场。

col: a chance to learn｜学习的机会
a good chance of｜很有可能
tip: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

senses.en: to become different, replace something, or exchange money
an instance or process of becoming different
coins, or money returned when you pay more than the price

ex.en: We changed our plans when the rain started falling.
ex.zh: 开始下雨时，我们改变了计划。

ex.en: Governments should change transport policies to encourage cycling and reduce dependence on private cars in cities.
ex.zh: 政府应调整交通政策，鼓励骑行并减少城市居民对私家车的依赖。

tip: 表示“零钱、找零”时不可数，不能说a change。

senses.en: Likely to change frequently or unexpectedly.

ex.en: Pack a light jacket because the weather is changeable.
ex.zh: 带上一件薄外套吧，因为天气多变。

ex.en: Farmers need reliable forecasts to plan their work effectively in regions with highly changeable weather.
ex.zh: 在天气高度多变的地区，农民需要可靠的预报来有效安排农活。

col: a changeable mood｜变化无常的情绪
tip: 常形容天气或情绪多变；注意保留change末尾的e。

senses.en: the qualities that make someone or something distinctive
a person represented in a story, play, or film
a written or printed symbol, such as a letter

ex.en: Her cheerful character makes even rainy mornings feel brighter.
ex.zh: 她开朗的性格让阴雨的早晨也显得明朗起来。

ex.en: Preserving historic buildings helps cities retain their distinctive character while adapting to modern economic demands.
ex.zh: 保护历史建筑有助于城市在适应现代经济需求的同时，保留自身的独特风貌。

tip: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

senses.en: A quality that is typical of a person or thing.
Typical of a particular person, thing, or group.

ex.en: One striking characteristic of this cat is its curly fur.
ex.zh: 这只猫的一个显著特征是卷曲的毛。

ex.en: The ability to adapt quickly is an important characteristic of successful businesses in a changing economy.
ex.zh: 在不断变化的经济环境中，快速适应能力是成功企业的重要特征。

tip: 形容词常用be characteristic of，表示是……的典型特征。

senses.en: an organisation that helps people or causes in need
help, especially money, given to those in need

ex.en: My sister volunteers at a charity that rescues dogs.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家救助狗的慈善机构做志愿者。

ex.en: Local charities can provide essential support, but governments remain responsible for ensuring access to basic services.
ex.zh: 地方慈善机构可以提供重要支持，但政府仍有责任保障基本服务的可及性。

col: donate to charity｜向慈善事业捐款
raise money for charity｜为慈善事业筹款
tip: 指机构时可数；指慈善事业或救济时不可数。

senses.en: To talk informally, in person or through electronic messages.
A friendly, informal conversation.

ex.en: We chatted about our weekend while waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 等公交车时，我们聊起了各自的周末。

ex.en: Community gardens allow neighbours to chat regularly, helping them build stronger relationships and reduce social isolation.
ex.zh: 社区花园让邻居能够经常闲聊，有助于加深彼此的关系，减少社交孤立。

tip: chat with人、about话题；过去式chatted双写t。

senses.en: costing little money or less than usual
of poor quality and little value

ex.en: We found a cheap café near the train station.
ex.zh: 我们在火车站附近找到了一家价格实惠的咖啡馆。

ex.en: Cheap public transport can improve access to employment and reduce dependence on private cars in large cities.
ex.zh: 价格低廉的公共交通能改善大城市居民的就业可达性，并减少对私家车的依赖。

col: a cheap alternative｜便宜的替代选择
tip: cheap有时暗示质量差；中性表达可用inexpensive。

ex.en: Please check your answers again.
ex.zh: 请再次检查你的答案。

ex.en: I checked the time before leaving home.
ex.zh: 离家前我看了一下时间。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: either side of the face below the eyes
rude behaviour that shows a lack of respect

ex.en: A cold raindrop landed on my cheek outside.
ex.zh: 在外面，一滴冰凉的雨水落在了我的脸颊上。

ex.en: Protective clothing should cover exposed areas, including the cheeks, when people work in extremely cold environments.
ex.zh: 在极寒环境中工作时，防护服应遮住包括脸颊在内的裸露部位。

col: a kiss on the cheek｜脸颊上的一吻
have the cheek to｜竟厚着脸皮做
tip: 脸颊义可数；无礼义通常不可数，多用于英式口语。

senses.en: shout happily to show approval or encouragement
a loud shout expressing happiness, approval, or encouragement
make someone feel happier or more hopeful

ex.en: We cheered as our neighbour crossed the finish line.
ex.zh: 邻居冲过终点线时，我们欢呼起来。

ex.en: When spectators cheer for every participant, community sporting events can foster a stronger sense of belonging.
ex.zh: 当观众为每位参与者喝彩时，社区体育活动能培养更强的归属感。

col: a loud cheer｜响亮的欢呼声
cheer for a team｜为球队喝彩
tip: cheer on指加油助威；cheer up指振作或使高兴。

senses.en: A food made by pressing or ripening the solids of milk.

ex.en: I added some cheese to my warm vegetable sandwich.
ex.zh: 我在热乎乎的蔬菜三明治里加了些奶酪。

ex.en: Although cheese provides protein and calcium, some varieties contain high levels of salt and saturated fat.
ex.zh: 虽然奶酪能提供蛋白质和钙，但有些品种的盐和饱和脂肪含量较高。

col: a slice of cheese｜一片奶酪
tip: 通常不可数；一块奶酪用a piece of cheese。

ex.en: A cheetah can run very fast.
ex.zh: 猎豹能跑得非常快。

ex.en: The cheetah uses its speed to catch food.
ex.zh: 猎豹利用速度捕捉食物。

col: a wild cheetah｜一只野生猎豹
tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: A scientist who studies chemicals and how they react.
A pharmacist, or a shop that sells medicines, in British English.

ex.en: The chemist carefully poured the liquid into a glass tube.
ex.zh: 化学研究员小心地把液体倒进玻璃试管。

ex.en: Chemists are developing safer materials that could reduce the environmental impact of industrial production.
ex.zh: 化学家正在研发更安全的材料，以减轻工业生产对环境的影响。

tip: 英式中还指药剂师；chemist's常指药店。

senses.en: the science of substances and how they react
the chemical properties and processes of a substance
a natural connection or attraction between people

ex.en: We mixed two clear liquids in chemistry class today.
ex.zh: 今天化学课上，我们把两种透明液体混合在一起。

ex.en: Understanding the chemistry of seawater helps scientists explain how rising carbon emissions affect marine life.
ex.zh: 了解海水的化学特性有助于科学家解释碳排放增加如何影响海洋生物。

tip: 学科名通常不可数：study chemistry，不加a。

senses.en: a two-player board game involving pieces with different permitted moves

ex.en: My grandfather taught me chess during the winter holidays.
ex.zh: 寒假期间，爷爷教我下国际象棋。

ex.en: Playing chess regularly may help children develop concentration and practise planning several steps ahead.
ex.zh: 经常下国际象棋可能有助于儿童提高专注力，并练习提前规划多个步骤。

tip: 说play chess，不加冠词the。

senses.en: A bird kept for its eggs or meat.
Meat from a chicken, eaten as food.

ex.en: The chickens scratched the soil beside our vegetable patch.
ex.zh: 那些鸡在我们的菜地旁刨土。

ex.en: Replacing some red meat with chicken can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.
ex.zh: 用鸡肉替代部分红肉，可以减少个人饮食对环境的影响。

tip: 指活鸡时可数，指鸡肉时不可数；小鸡常用chick。

senses.en: Most important among several things.
Having the highest rank in an organisation or profession.
The person who leads a group or organisation.

ex.en: My chief concern is getting everyone home safely.
ex.zh: 我最关心的是让大家安全到家。

ex.en: The chief advantage of public transport is its ability to move large crowds while using less road space.
ex.zh: 公共交通的主要优势在于能用较少的道路空间运送大量乘客。

tip: chief可作形容词或名词；副词用chiefly。

senses.en: a young person who has not yet become an adult
someone's son or daughter, regardless of age

ex.en: The child carefully carried a bowl of water outside.
ex.zh: 那个孩子小心翼翼地端着一碗水走到外面。

ex.en: Every child should have access to quality education, regardless of family income or place of residence.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都应享有优质教育，不论其家庭收入或居住地点如何。

tip: 复数是children；childish偏贬义，childlike指天真如孩童。

senses.en: the period of life when someone is a child

ex.en: My happiest childhood memories involve baking with my grandmother.
ex.zh: 我最快乐的童年记忆都与和祖母一起烘焙有关。

ex.en: Access to safe outdoor spaces during childhood can support physical development and emotional wellbeing.
ex.zh: 童年时期能够使用安全的户外空间，有助于身体发育和心理健康。

tip: during childhood泛指童年；in my childhood指我的童年。

senses.en: a country in East Asia

ex.en: My cousin returned from China with beautiful mountain photographs.
ex.zh: 我的表亲从中国回来，带回了漂亮的山景照片。

ex.en: The expansion of high-speed rail in China illustrates how transport investment can improve connections between major cities.
ex.zh: 中国高铁网络的扩展说明了交通投资如何改善主要城市之间的联系。

tip: China指中国；小写china指瓷器，形容词用Chinese。

senses.en: Relating to China, its people, or its languages.
The group of languages spoken in China, especially Mandarin.
People who come from China.

ex.en: We shared Chinese dumplings at a small restaurant yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在一家小餐馆一起吃了中式饺子。

ex.en: Learning Chinese can help international students develop a deeper understanding of cultural traditions in China.
ex.zh: 学习汉语可以帮助国际学生更深入地了解中国的文化传统。

tip: 首字母始终大写；指一个中国人常用a Chinese person。

senses.en: a tiny electronic component containing many connected circuits
a small broken piece or the mark it leaves
to break a small piece off something

ex.en: The repairer replaced a damaged chip inside my laptop.
ex.zh: 维修人员更换了我笔记本电脑内部一块损坏的芯片。

ex.en: Demand for advanced chips is increasing as more industries adopt artificial intelligence and automated production systems.
ex.zh: 随着更多行业采用人工智能和自动化生产系统，对先进芯片的需求正在增长。

col: a chip in a cup｜杯子上的缺口
chip a tooth｜磕掉一小块牙齿
tip: 食物中的chips：英式指薯条，美式通常指薯片。

senses.en: A sweet food made from cocoa, often with milk and sugar.
An individual sweet made of chocolate, sometimes with a filling.

ex.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
ex.zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。

col: a bar of chocolate｜一块巧克力
a box of chocolates｜一盒巧克力糖
tip: 食材巧克力不可数；单颗巧克力糖可数。

senses.en: the act or freedom of choosing between different possibilities
something you can choose, or the range of available options
of especially good quality

ex.en: You have a choice between soup and salad.
ex.zh: 你可以在汤和沙拉之间选择。

ex.en: Reliable public transport gives commuters a wider choice and reduces their dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通为通勤者提供更多选择，并减少他们对私家车的依赖。

col: a wide choice of｜种类丰富的
tip: choice是名词，choose是动词；选择做某事用choose to do。

senses.en: to decide which person or thing you want
to decide to do something rather than something else

ex.en: You can choose a seat beside the window.
ex.zh: 你可以选一个靠窗的座位。

ex.en: Many students choose to study abroad because they want to experience different cultures and teaching methods.
ex.zh: 许多学生选择出国留学，因为他们想体验不同的文化和教学方法。

col: choose to do something｜选择做某事
tip: 过去式chose，过去分词chosen；后接to do。

ex.en: I can use chopsticks to eat noodles.
ex.zh: 我会用筷子吃面条。

ex.en: Put the chopsticks beside the bowl.
ex.zh: 把筷子放在碗旁边。

col: a pair of chopsticks｜一双筷子
tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

ex.en: Washing the dishes is my daily chore.
ex.zh: 洗碗是我每天的家务。

ex.en: We share the chores at home.
ex.zh: 我们在家分担家务。

tip: 小学教材补充词：先听发音，再结合例句理解，最后用这个词说一句自己的话。
note: 依据小学教材词表整理；释义、例句与插画为本站补充内容，不属于词光官方原词条。

senses.en: the Christian festival celebrating Jesus's birth, or the surrounding period

ex.en: Our family usually shares a special meal at Christmas.
ex.zh: 我们一家通常在圣诞节一起享用一顿特别的饭菜。

ex.en: During Christmas, increased consumer spending can benefit local shops, although it may also generate additional packaging waste.
ex.zh: 圣诞节期间，消费支出的增加可以使当地商店受益，但也可能产生更多包装废弃物。

tip: 首字母大写；节日期间用at，当天用on Christmas Day。

senses.en: A round shape whose edge is equally distant from its centre.
A group of people connected by friendship or shared interests.
To move around something or draw a ring around it.

ex.en: The children sat in a circle on the grass.
ex.zh: 孩子们在草地上围坐成一圈。

ex.en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
ex.zh: 参加社区活动可以帮助老年人扩大社交圈，减少孤独感。

tip: circle是圆或圆圈；cycle才常指循环或周期。

senses.en: A legal member of a country with rights and responsibilities.
A person who lives in a particular town or city.

ex.en: My aunt became a citizen after living here for years.
ex.zh: 我姑妈在这里生活多年后成为了公民。

ex.en: Every citizen should have access to reliable public services, regardless of income or place of residence.
ex.zh: 每位公民都应享有可靠的公共服务，不论收入多少或居住在哪里。

col: a responsible citizen｜负责任的公民
tip: citizen强调公民身份；resident强调居住。

senses.en: an organized society with developed institutions, culture, and technology
the comforts and services associated with modern society

ex.en: We explored the ruins of an ancient civilization yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们探访了一处古代文明的遗址。

ex.en: Reliable water supplies played a crucial role in the development of civilization by supporting agriculture and permanent settlements.
ex.zh: 可靠的水源支持了农业和固定聚落的发展，在文明形成过程中发挥了关键作用。

col: the rise of civilization｜文明的兴起
tip: 英式也拼作 civilisation；某个文明可用 a civilization。

senses.en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend.
A social group or category sharing particular characteristics.
To place someone or something in a particular category.

ex.en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们班正在学习如何种蔬菜。

ex.en: Smaller class sizes may allow teachers to give more individual attention to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 较小的班级规模可能让教师给予学习有困难的学生更多个别关注。

tip: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

senses.en: Widely admired for lasting quality and value.
Showing the most recognizable features of a particular kind.
A work admired over time for its excellent quality.

ex.en: We watched a classic film together after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们一起看了一部经典电影。

ex.en: This housing project is a classic example of how thoughtful design can improve urban life.
ex.zh: 这个住宅项目是精心设计如何改善城市生活的典型例子。

tip: classic指经典或典型；古典音乐用classical。

senses.en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.

ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
ex.zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

ex.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

col: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学
help a classmate｜帮助同班同学
tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

senses.en: a room where students are taught

ex.en: Sunlight filled the classroom as we opened our books.
ex.zh: 我们打开书本时，阳光洒满了教室。

ex.en: A well-designed classroom should provide adequate lighting, comfortable furniture, and enough space for students to work together.
ex.zh: 设计良好的教室应有充足的照明、舒适的家具，以及供学生合作学习的足够空间。

tip: in the classroom强调教室内；in class强调上课中。

senses.en: A separate condition or requirement in a legal document.
A group of words containing a subject and a verb.

ex.en: One clause in our lease allows us to keep pets.
ex.zh: 我们的租约中有一项条款允许养宠物。

ex.en: Employment contracts should include a clause that clearly defines workers' rights to paid leave and flexible working.
ex.zh: 劳动合同应包含明确规定员工带薪休假和弹性工作权利的条款。

col: a clause in a contract｜合同中的条款
include a clause｜加入一项条款
tip: 语法中clause含主语和谓语；phrase通常不含。

senses.en: Heavy earth that can be shaped when wet and baked hard.

ex.en: The children shaped wet clay into tiny bowls.
ex.zh: 孩子们把湿陶土捏成了小碗。

ex.en: Traditional clay buildings can provide effective insulation, helping communities maintain comfortable indoor temperatures with less energy.
ex.zh: 传统黏土建筑能有效隔热，帮助社区以更少的能源维持舒适的室内温度。

tip: 通常不可数；a piece of clay表示一块黏土。

senses.en: Free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.
To remove dirt or unwanted substances from something.
Producing little or no pollution.

ex.en: There are clean towels on the shelf beside you.
ex.zh: 你旁边的架子上有干净的毛巾。

ex.en: Investing in clean energy can reduce air pollution while creating new employment opportunities in developing industries.
ex.zh: 投资清洁能源可以减少空气污染，同时在新兴产业中创造就业机会。

tip: clean是干净；clear是清澈或清楚，不能随意互换。

senses.en: a person paid to clean buildings or rooms
a substance or device used to remove dirt
having less dirt or causing less pollution

ex.en: The cleaner emptied the bins before the office opened.
ex.zh: 清洁工在办公室开门前清空了垃圾桶。

ex.en: Hospitals should provide every cleaner with suitable protective equipment and training to reduce infection risks.
ex.zh: 医院应为每位清洁工提供合适的防护装备和培训，以降低感染风险。

col: window cleaner｜窗户清洁工；玻璃清洁剂
tip: a cleaner通常指清洁工；cleaner也是clean的比较级。

senses.en: Easy to understand, see, or hear
Free from cloud, dirt, or anything blocking light
To remove unwanted things from a place

ex.en: The instructions were clear, so I assembled the shelf easily.
ex.zh: 说明很清楚，所以我轻松地组装好了架子。

ex.en: Public health campaigns should provide clear advice that people from different educational backgrounds can easily understand.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传应提供明确的建议，让不同教育背景的人都能轻松理解。

col: crystal clear｜清澈透明的；非常清楚的
tip: make it clear that…表示明确说明……。

senses.en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, or understand.
In a way that shows something is obviously true.

ex.en: Please speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
ex.zh: 请说清楚些，让大家都能听清。

ex.en: Public health information should clearly explain the benefits and potential risks of any recommended treatment.
ex.zh: 公共卫生信息应清楚说明任何推荐疗法的益处和潜在风险。

tip: 句首Clearly常表示“显然”，而非“清晰地”。

senses.en: Quick to learn, understand, or find solutions.
Showing skill or an original way of solving a problem.

ex.en: That clever child fixed the puzzle before lunch.
ex.zh: 那个聪明的孩子午饭前就解开了这道谜题。

ex.en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
ex.zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。

tip: 比较级cleverer，最高级cleverest。

senses.en: to press a mouse button or select something on screen
a short sharp sound, or an action selecting something onscreen
to suddenly become clear or understood

ex.en: Click on the picture to see a larger version.
ex.zh: 点击图片即可查看大图。

ex.en: Students should check whether a website is trustworthy before they click on links or share personal information.
ex.zh: 学生在点击链接或分享个人信息前，应检查网站是否可信。

col: click on a link｜点击链接
a mouse click｜一次鼠标点击
a sharp click｜清脆的咔嗒声
tip: 点击链接常用click on；it clicked可指突然想通了。

senses.en: The typical weather conditions of a place over many years.
The general attitudes and conditions within a society or organisation.

ex.en: These plants grow well in a warm, dry climate.
ex.zh: 这些植物在温暖干燥的气候中长得很好。

ex.en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
ex.zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。

tip: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

senses.en: The most exciting or important point of an event
Reach the most exciting or important point

ex.en: The concert reached its climax when the whole choir joined.
ex.zh: 整个合唱团加入演唱时，音乐会达到了高潮。

ex.en: The film reaches its climax when the community unites to protect the forest from destruction.
ex.zh: 当社区居民团结起来保护森林免遭破坏时，影片达到了高潮。

col: a dramatic climax｜扣人心弦的高潮
tip: climactic指高潮的；别与climatic（气候的）混淆。

senses.en: to move upwards using your feet and often your hands
to increase in amount or level
an act of moving upwards or an increase in level

ex.en: We climbed the hill before stopping for a picnic.
ex.zh: 我们爬上山坡，然后停下来野餐。

ex.en: As housing costs continue to climb, many young adults struggle to live independently in major cities.
ex.zh: 随着住房成本持续上涨，许多年轻人难以在大城市独立生活。

col: a steep climb｜陡峭的攀登路段
tip: 词尾b不发音；climb a mountain不加介词。

senses.en: The sport of going up rocks, mountains, or artificial walls.
Growing upwards by attaching to or winding around supports.

ex.en: I tried indoor climbing with my sister yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我和姐姐尝试了室内攀岩。

ex.en: Schools can use supervised climbing activities to develop students' confidence, physical coordination, and ability to assess risks.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过有人指导的攀岩活动，培养学生的自信、身体协调性和风险评估能力。

tip: climb中的b不发音；climbing plants指攀缘植物。

senses.en: a device that shows the time
to measure or record the time or speed of something

ex.en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
ex.zh: 我们做午饭时，厨房的时钟停了。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.
ex.zh: 弹性工作安排让员工在效率最高时工作，而不是盯着时钟等下班。

col: watch the clock｜盯着时间等下班
tip: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

senses.en: Shut something or bring an activity to an end
Near in distance or connected by a strong personal relationship
At a short distance from someone or something

ex.en: Please close the window before the rain comes in.
ex.zh: 请在雨飘进来之前关上窗户。

ex.en: When local libraries close, residents lose valuable spaces for independent learning and community activities.
ex.zh: 当本地图书馆关闭时，居民就失去了自主学习和开展社区活动的宝贵场所。

tip: 动词读/z/；形容词和副词读/s/。

senses.en: not open
not available for business or public use
unwilling to consider different ideas

ex.en: Keep the window closed while the heating is on.
ex.zh: 开着暖气时，请把窗户关好。

ex.en: When local libraries remain closed at weekends, working families have fewer opportunities to access educational resources.
ex.zh: 如果当地图书馆周末不开放，上班族家庭获取教育资源的机会就会减少。

col: keep something closed｜使某物保持关闭
tip: 形容词意为“关着的”；也是close的过去式和过去分词。

senses.en: Material made by weaving or knitting fibres.
A piece of fabric used for cleaning or covering things.

ex.en: She chose soft cotton cloth for the baby's blanket.
ex.zh: 她选了柔软的棉布来做婴儿毯。

ex.en: Replacing disposable wipes with reusable cloth can reduce household waste and lower long-term cleaning costs.
ex.zh: 用可重复使用的布代替一次性湿巾，可以减少家庭垃圾并降低长期清洁成本。

tip: 布料义不可数；抹布可数，复数cloths；勿混clothes。

senses.en: items worn to cover the body

ex.en: Your clean clothes are drying outside in the sunshine.
ex.zh: 你洗干净的衣服正在外面晒太阳。

ex.en: Buying durable clothes rather than frequently replacing cheap garments can reduce household waste and save resources.
ex.zh: 购买耐穿的衣服，而不是频繁更换廉价服装，可以减少家庭垃圾并节约资源。

tip: 只有复数形式；一件衣服用an item of clothing。

senses.en: a visible mass of tiny water drops in the sky
a mass of smoke, dust, or similar material in air
to make thoughts or judgment less clear

ex.en: A dark cloud drifted slowly across the afternoon sky.
ex.zh: 一朵乌云缓缓飘过午后的天空。

ex.en: Strong emotions can cloud public judgment when communities debate the benefits and risks of new technologies.
ex.zh: 当社区讨论新技术的利弊时，强烈的情绪可能影响公众的判断。

col: a cloud of dust｜一团尘土
cloud someone's judgment｜影响某人的判断
tip: cloud作动词可指使判断不清，如cloud your judgment。

senses.en: having many clouds in the sky
not clear or transparent

ex.en: It was cloudy, so we left our sunglasses at home.
ex.zh: 当时天阴着，所以我们把太阳镜留在了家里。

ex.en: Solar panels can still generate electricity on cloudy days, although their output is usually lower.
ex.zh: 太阳能电池板在阴天仍能发电，不过发电量通常较低。

tip: 既可形容天空多云，也可形容液体浑浊。

senses.en: an organisation whose members share an interest or activity
a place where people dance and socialise at night
a stick used to hit a golf ball or strike something

ex.en: I joined a chess club to meet new people.
ex.zh: 我加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部，想认识些新朋友。

ex.en: A school sports club can help students develop teamwork skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 学校体育社团可以帮助学生培养团队合作能力，同时鼓励他们经常锻炼。

tip: join a club表示加入社团，不用join in a club。

senses.en: the land along the edge of the sea
to move without using power or much effort
to succeed or progress without trying very hard

ex.en: We walked along the coast and collected smooth stones.
ex.zh: 我们沿着海岸散步，捡了一些光滑的石头。

ex.en: Communities along the coast face increasing risks from rising sea levels and severe storms.
ex.zh: 沿海社区面临着海平面上升和强风暴带来的日益严重的风险。

tip: on the coast指在海边；off the coast指在近海。

senses.en: an outer garment worn for warmth or protection
a layer of paint or another covering substance
cover a surface with a layer of something

ex.en: Hang your wet coat by the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 把你的湿外套挂在厨房门边。

ex.en: Applying a protective coat to metal structures can reduce maintenance costs and extend their useful life.
ex.zh: 给金属结构涂上保护层可以降低维护成本，延长其使用寿命。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: 动词常用coat A with B，意为给A涂上B。

senses.en: A large tropical fruit with a hard shell and white flesh.
The white flesh of a coconut, used as food.

ex.en: We shared a fresh coconut beside the beach.
ex.zh: 我们在海滩边分着吃了一个新鲜椰子。

ex.en: Coastal farmers can earn additional income by processing coconut shells into useful household products.
ex.zh: 沿海农民可以通过将椰壳加工成实用的家居用品来增加收入。

tip: 指整颗椰子可数，指椰肉通常不可数。

senses.en: A drink made from roasted beans, or the beans and powder.

ex.en: I drink coffee with milk before leaving for work.
ex.zh: 我上班出门前会喝一杯加奶咖啡。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may threaten coffee production, affecting the incomes of farmers in several developing countries.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能威胁咖啡生产，影响一些发展中国家农民的收入。

col: a cup of coffee｜一杯咖啡
tip: 通常不可数；点单时two coffees指两杯咖啡。

senses.en: a small, flat piece of metal used as money
to invent a new word or expression

ex.en: A silver coin rolled under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 一枚银色硬币滚到了厨房桌子下面。

ex.en: As digital payments become more widespread, fewer consumers carry coins for everyday purchases such as bus fares.
ex.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，随身携带硬币用于公交车费等日常支出的人越来越少。

tip: coin作动词常指创造词语，如coin a term。

senses.en: Having a low temperature or feeling a lack of warmth.
A common illness causing sneezing, coughing, and a runny nose.
Showing little friendliness, affection, or sympathy.

ex.en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
ex.zh: 我的手很冷，于是戴上了手套。

ex.en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。

tip: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。

senses.en: To gather things together or keep objects as a hobby
To go somewhere and bring someone or something away
To receive or gather money from people

ex.en: I collect smooth stones whenever we visit the beach.
ex.zh: 每次去海边，我都会收集光滑的石头。

ex.en: Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.
ex.zh: 研究人员收集当地家庭的数据，以评估交通政策如何影响日常出行习惯。

tip: 英式英语collect someone可指去接某人。

senses.en: a group of objects kept or presented together
the act of gathering or taking things away
the gathering of money from people for a purpose

ex.en: My aunt keeps her shell collection in a cabinet.
ex.zh: 我姑姑把她收藏的贝壳放在柜子里。

ex.en: Regular household waste collection is essential for protecting public health and maintaining a clean urban environment.
ex.zh: 定期收运生活垃圾对于保护公众健康和保持城市环境整洁至关重要。

tip: a collection of后接复数名词，表示一批相关物品。

senses.en: An institution offering education beyond school, including practical or academic courses.
A constituent institution or division within a university.

ex.en: My cousin is studying nursing at a local college.
ex.zh: 我表姐正在当地一所学院学习护理。

ex.en: Making college education more affordable could improve social mobility and provide employers with a more skilled workforce.
ex.zh: 降低高等教育费用可以促进社会流动，并为雇主提供技能更强的劳动力。

col: go to college｜上大学或学院
tip: 美式常泛指大学；英式多指学院或继续教育院校。

senses.en: The appearance of something as red, blue, green, and so on.
To give something a colour using pencils, paint, or dye.

ex.en: What colour should we paint the kitchen walls?
ex.zh: 我们该把厨房的墙刷成什么颜色？

ex.en: The colour of classroom walls may influence students' moods and their ability to concentrate.
ex.zh: 教室墙壁的颜色可能影响学生的情绪和专注能力。

col: colour in a picture｜给图画涂色
tip: 英式拼写为colour，美式为color。

senses.zh: 色彩鲜艳的；五彩缤纷的
senses.en: Having many bright colours

senses.zh: 生动有趣的；丰富多彩的
senses.en: Full of interesting, unusual or exciting details

ex.en: Colourful balloons floated above the tables at the party.
ex.zh: 聚会上，五彩缤纷的气球飘浮在桌子上方。

ex.en: Colourful public murals can transform neglected urban spaces and encourage residents to take pride in their neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 色彩鲜艳的公共壁画能改变被忽视的城市空间，增强居民对社区的自豪感。

col: a colourful character｜有趣独特的人物
a colourful history｜丰富多彩的历史
tip: 英式拼写colourful，美式拼写colorful。

senses.en: physically pleasant and free from discomfort
feeling relaxed and confident in a situation
having enough money to live well without financial worry

ex.en: This soft chair is comfortable enough for an afternoon nap.
ex.zh: 这把柔软的椅子很舒服，足以让人午睡一会儿。

ex.en: Comfortable classrooms with adequate lighting can help students concentrate and participate more actively in lessons.
ex.zh: 舒适且照明充足的教室有助于学生集中注意力，更积极地参与课堂活动。

col: comfortable with something｜对某事感到自在
tip: comfortable指舒服；convenient指方便。

senses.en: something said or written to express an opinion or observation
to express an opinion or observation about something

ex.en: Her kind comment about my painting made me smile.
ex.zh: 她对我画作的友善评价让我笑了。

ex.en: Residents should have opportunities to comment on development proposals before local authorities make final decisions.
ex.zh: 地方政府作出最终决定前，居民应有机会对开发提案发表意见。

tip: 动词comment后接on再接评论对象，不直接接宾语。

senses.en: happening often or found in many places
shared by two or more people or groups

ex.en: Heavy rain is common here during the summer.
ex.zh: 这里夏天经常下大雨。

ex.en: Governments should address the common challenges that prevent rural communities from accessing affordable healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应解决阻碍农村社区获得可负担医疗服务的共同难题。

col: have something in common｜有共同之处
tip: common指常见或共有；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

senses.en: to share information, thoughts, or feelings with others
to make information or feelings known to someone

ex.en: We communicate with our neighbours through a shared online group.
ex.zh: 我们通过一个共同的线上群组与邻居交流。

ex.en: Teachers need to communicate complex ideas clearly so that students with different abilities can understand them.
ex.zh: 教师需要清晰地传达复杂概念，让能力不同的学生都能理解。

tip: 与某人交流用with；向某人传达某事用某事＋to。

senses.en: the process of sharing information, ideas, or feelings
a formal message sent to someone

ex.en: Clear communication helps us share the kitchen without arguments.
ex.zh: 清晰的沟通让我们共用厨房时不发生争执。

ex.en: Effective communication between healthcare professionals and patients can improve treatment outcomes and reduce misunderstandings.
ex.zh: 医护人员与患者之间的有效沟通可以改善治疗效果，减少误解。

col: a breakdown in communication｜沟通中断
tip: 表交流通常不可数；表一封正式函件可数。

senses.en: people living in the same area
people sharing interests, beliefs, or a particular background

ex.en: Our community gathers every spring to clean the park.
ex.zh: 我们社区的居民每年春天都会一起清理公园。

ex.en: Public libraries strengthen the local community by providing free learning spaces and opportunities for social interaction.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费的学习空间和社交机会，从而增强当地社区的凝聚力。

tip: 既指同地区居民，也指有共同背景或兴趣的群体。

senses.en: To examine things to find similarities and differences.
To describe something as similar to another thing.
To be as good as, or similar to, something else.

ex.en: We compared several backpacks before choosing the lightest one.
ex.zh: 我们比较了几个背包，最后选了最轻的那个。

ex.en: Researchers should compare the long-term costs of renewable energy with those of traditional power sources.
ex.zh: 研究人员应比较可再生能源与传统能源的长期成本。

col: compare A with B｜将A与B比较
compare A to B｜将A比作B；比较A和B
compare favourably with｜比起来不逊于
tip: 比较可用with或to；表示比喻时通常用to。

senses.en: The effort to succeed against others seeking the same goal.
An organised event in which people try to win.

ex.en: Our school is holding a painting competition next Friday.
ex.zh: 我们学校下周五要举办绘画比赛。

ex.en: Competition between businesses can lower prices, but effective regulation is needed to protect consumers from unfair practices.
ex.zh: 企业间的竞争可以降低价格，但仍需有效监管来保护消费者免受不公平商业行为的侵害。

tip: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

senses.en: to finish doing something or filling in information
having every necessary part, with nothing missing
total, without any limit or exception

ex.en: I completed the puzzle just before dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 我刚拼好拼图，晚饭就做好了。

ex.en: Students who complete vocational training often gain practical skills that help them enter the workforce more confidently.
ex.zh: 完成职业培训的学生往往能获得实用技能，从而更有信心地进入职场。

tip: complete a form指填写完表格，不是制作表格。

senses.en: In every way or to the fullest possible degree.

ex.en: My shoes were completely wet after walking through the rain.
ex.zh: 在雨中走过之后，我的鞋全湿透了。

ex.en: Although online courses offer flexibility, they cannot completely replace the social benefits of classroom learning.
ex.zh: 虽然在线课程提供了灵活性，但它们无法完全取代课堂学习带来的社交益处。

tip: 表示程度达到全部，常修饰形容词或动词。

senses.en: An electronic machine that stores and processes information using programs.

ex.en: My computer froze while I was editing holiday photos.
ex.zh: 我编辑度假照片时，电脑卡住了。

ex.en: Access to a computer at home can help students complete assignments and develop essential digital skills.
ex.zh: 在家能使用电脑可以帮助学生完成作业，并培养必要的数字技能。

tip: 在电脑上工作用work on a computer。

senses.en: a live musical performance given before an audience

ex.en: We enjoyed an outdoor concert in the park yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们在公园欣赏了一场露天音乐会。

ex.en: Free public concerts can make cultural activities more accessible and encourage residents to use shared urban spaces.
ex.zh: 免费公共音乐会能让更多人参与文化活动，并鼓励居民使用城市公共空间。

tip: 去听音乐会用 go to a concert。

senses.en: a judgement formed after considering facts or evidence
the final part or ending of something

ex.en: We reached the same conclusion after checking the receipts.
ex.zh: 核对收据后，我们得出了相同的结论。

ex.en: Researchers should consider alternative explanations before drawing a conclusion from a relatively small sample.
ex.zh: 研究人员根据较小的样本得出结论之前，应考虑其他可能的解释。

tip: “得出结论”用reach或draw a conclusion，不用make。

senses.en: The physical state of someone or something
A requirement, or circumstances affecting life or activity
A medical problem affecting someone's health

ex.en: Despite its age, this bicycle is in excellent condition.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车虽然年头已久，但状况极佳。

ex.en: Improving working conditions can increase employee satisfaction and reduce the number of people leaving their jobs.
ex.zh: 改善工作条件可以提高员工满意度，并减少离职人数。

tip: 表状态通常不可数；表工作、生活环境常用复数。

senses.en: Belief in your abilities or in a successful outcome.
Trust that someone or something is reliable.

ex.en: Practising with friends gave me confidence before the interview.
ex.zh: 和朋友一起练习让我在面试前有了信心。

ex.en: Supportive feedback can build students' confidence and encourage them to participate more actively in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 鼓励性的反馈可以增强学生的自信，促使他们更积极地参与课堂讨论。

col: confidence in someone｜对某人的信任
tip: 对某人或某事有信心用confidence in。

senses.en: believing in your own ability to succeed
certain that something is true or will happen

ex.en: After weeks of practice, I felt confident on stage.
ex.zh: 经过几周练习，我站在台上时感到很自信。

ex.en: Students become more confident when teachers provide constructive feedback and opportunities to practise new skills.
ex.zh: 当教师提供建设性反馈和练习新技能的机会时，学生会变得更自信。

col: confident about the future｜对未来有信心
tip: confident是形容词；confidence是名词。

senses.en: unable to understand something or think clearly
unclear or difficult to follow because of poor organisation

ex.en: I felt confused when both doors led outside.
ex.zh: 两扇门都通向外面，让我感到困惑。

ex.en: Students may become confused if teachers introduce too many unfamiliar concepts in a single lesson.
ex.zh: 如果教师在一堂课中引入太多陌生概念，学生可能会感到困惑。

tip: confused形容人困惑；confusing形容事物令人困惑。

senses.en: Tell someone you are pleased about their success or good fortune.

ex.en: We called to congratulate Lina on her new job.
ex.zh: 我们打电话祝贺莉娜找到新工作。

ex.en: Schools should congratulate students on personal improvement rather than focus exclusively on high examination scores.
ex.zh: 学校应祝贺学生取得个人进步，而不是只关注高考试分数。

col: congratulate someone on something｜就某事祝贺某人
congratulate someone warmly｜热烈祝贺某人
tip: 用congratulate sb on sth，介词不是for。

senses.en: An expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune.

ex.en: We sent our congratulations when she passed her driving test.
ex.zh: 她通过驾驶考试后，我们向她表示祝贺。

ex.en: Offering congratulations to students who achieve personal goals can strengthen their confidence and encourage further learning.
ex.zh: 向实现个人目标的学生表示祝贺，可以增强他们的信心，并鼓励他们继续学习。

tip: 祝贺通常用复数congratulations，后接on加成就。

senses.en: to join things together or link them electronically
to recognize or establish a relationship between things
to develop a good relationship with someone

ex.en: Connect your phone to the speaker using this cable.
ex.zh: 用这根线把手机连接到音箱上。

ex.en: New rail services can connect rural communities with cities, improving access to education and employment.
ex.zh: 新的铁路服务可以连接农村社区与城市，让人们更容易获得教育和就业机会。

col: connect to the internet｜连接互联网
connect A with B｜把A与B联系起来
connect with people｜与人建立联系
tip: 连接设备常用connect A to B。

senses.en: a relationship between people, things, or ideas
a link that allows devices or systems to work together
a further bus, train, or flight taken during a journey

ex.en: Our internet connection stopped working during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，我们的网络连接中断了。

ex.en: Researchers have found a strong connection between regular physical activity and improved mental health among young adults.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现，经常进行体育活动与年轻成年人心理健康改善之间存在密切联系。

tip: 表示两者的联系用connection between A and B。

senses.en: to think carefully about something before deciding
to have a particular opinion about someone or something
to take someone or something into account

ex.en: We're considering taking the train instead of driving tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我们正在考虑明天坐火车，而不开车。

ex.en: Governments should consider the long-term environmental costs before approving major construction projects in sensitive coastal areas.
ex.zh: 政府在批准生态敏感沿海地区的大型建设项目之前，应考虑其长期环境成本。

col: consider all options｜考虑所有选择
be considered essential｜被认为必不可少
tip: “考虑做”用consider doing，不用consider to do。

senses.en: Communication with someone, or physical touching between things.
To communicate with someone by calling, writing, or another method.
Someone you know who can offer help or information.

ex.en: Please contact the receptionist if you lose your key.
ex.zh: 如果你丢了钥匙，请联系接待员。

ex.en: Regular contact with family members can reduce loneliness among older people who live alone.
ex.zh: 经常与家人联系可以减轻独居老年人的孤独感。

col: keep in contact with｜与……保持联系
tip: 动词contact直接接人，不加with；名词后可加with。

senses.en: an event or struggle in which people compete to win
to formally challenge a decision, claim, or result
to compete for a position, prize, or political seat

ex.en: My cousin won a baking contest with her lemon cake.
ex.zh: 我表姐凭她做的柠檬蛋糕赢得了烘焙比赛。

ex.en: Citizens should have access to affordable legal advice when they wish to contest an official decision.
ex.zh: 公民希望对官方决定提出异议时，应能获得价格合理的法律咨询。

col: a close contest｜势均力敌的比赛
contest a decision｜对决定提出异议
tip: 名词重音在首音节；动词重音在第二音节。

senses.en: To keep doing something or keep happening.
To start again after a pause or interruption.

ex.en: We continued walking along the beach despite the rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是继续沿着海滩走。

ex.en: If housing costs continue to rise, more young adults may struggle to live independently in major cities.
ex.zh: 如果住房成本持续上涨，更多年轻人可能难以在大城市独立生活。

tip: 可接to do或doing，通常都表示继续做某事。

senses.en: Something done or provided to help achieve a shared result.
Money or goods given to support a person or cause.
A piece of writing supplied for a publication.

ex.en: Your contribution helped us finish the garden before sunset.
ex.zh: 有了你的帮助，我们在日落前完成了花园的整理工作。

ex.en: Public libraries make a valuable contribution to lifelong learning by providing free access to information.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通过免费提供信息资源，为终身学习作出了宝贵贡献。

col: make a contribution to｜为…作出贡献
tip: 常用make a contribution to；to后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: The power to direct or limit someone or something.
To direct, manage, or limit someone or something.
A device used to operate a machine or vehicle.

ex.en: Keep control of the kite by holding the string firmly.
ex.zh: 抓紧风筝线，控制好风筝。

ex.en: Stricter control of industrial emissions could improve air quality and reduce health risks in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 更严格地控制工业排放可以改善空气质量，并降低人口密集城市的健康风险。

tip: 过去式controlled、现在分词controlling均双写l。

senses.en: Easy to use or suitable for your needs and plans.
Situated close to somewhere you need to reach.

ex.en: Is Saturday morning a convenient time for your visit?
ex.zh: 你周六上午来方便吗？

ex.en: Online learning offers a convenient way for working adults to develop skills without travelling to a campus.
ex.zh: 在线学习为在职成年人提供了无需前往校园就能提升技能的便捷途径。

col: a convenient way to｜做……的便捷方式
tip: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

senses.en: A talk in which people exchange ideas, feelings, or information.

ex.en: We had a friendly conversation while waiting for the bus.
ex.zh: 等公交车时，我们友好地聊了一会儿。

ex.en: Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.
ex.zh: 经常与语言流利的人交谈有助于语言学习者建立信心并提高听力。

tip: 与某人谈某事：have a conversation with某人about某事。

senses.en: to prepare food by heating it, or become ready through heating
someone who prepares and cooks food

ex.en: I usually cook vegetable soup when the weather turns cold.
ex.zh: 天气变冷时，我通常会煮蔬菜汤。

ex.en: Teaching children to cook simple meals can encourage healthier eating habits and greater independence later in life.
ex.zh: 教孩子做简单饭菜，可以培养更健康的饮食习惯，让他们日后更加独立。

col: cook from scratch｜从原材料开始做饭
a good cook｜做饭好吃的人
cook over low heat｜用小火烹调
tip: cook可指厨师；cooker在英式英语中指炉灶。

senses.en: A small, flat, sweet baked food

senses.zh: 网站存于设备的小型数据
senses.en: A small piece of data a website stores on your device

ex.en: There is one chocolate cookie left in the jar.
ex.zh: 罐子里还剩一块巧克力曲奇。

ex.en: Websites often use cookies to remember user preferences, but some also track browsing behaviour.
ex.zh: 网站常用cookie记住用户偏好，但有些也会追踪浏览行为。

col: chocolate chip cookie｜巧克力豆曲奇
tip: 美式泛指小甜饼；网站cookie不等同于缓存文件。

senses.en: slightly cold, often in a pleasant way
calm and able to think clearly under pressure
to become or make something less hot

ex.en: A cool breeze drifted through the open kitchen window.
ex.zh: 一阵凉爽的微风从敞开的厨房窗户吹了进来。

ex.en: Planting more trees can help cool urban areas and reduce energy demand during summer.
ex.zh: 种植更多树木有助于为城市地区降温，并减少夏季的能源需求。

tip: cool 比 cold 温和；口语中还可表示“很酷的”。

senses.en: tiny sea animals, or the hard structures they build
having a pinkish-orange colour

ex.en: Bright fish swam between branches of coral beneath us.
ex.zh: 色彩鲜艳的鱼在我们下方的珊瑚枝间游动。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures threaten coral reefs, which provide essential habitats for many marine species.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升威胁着珊瑚礁，而珊瑚礁为许多海洋物种提供了重要栖息地。

tip: 指珊瑚材料通常不可数；指种类或群体时可用corals。

senses.en: a tall crop with large heads of yellow edible seeds
grain crops such as wheat or barley, especially in British English

ex.en: We grilled fresh corn and served it with butter.
ex.zh: 我们烤了新鲜玉米，配着黄油一起吃。

ex.en: Farmers growing corn may need more efficient irrigation systems as droughts become increasingly frequent.
ex.zh: 随着干旱日益频繁，种植玉米的农民可能需要更高效的灌溉系统。

tip: 美式corn通常指玉米；英式也可泛指谷物。

senses.en: A place where two sides, walls, or streets meet.
To trap someone so they cannot escape or avoid answering.

ex.en: We put a small lamp in the corner.
ex.zh: 我们在角落里放了一盏小灯。

ex.en: Shops on street corners can encourage walking by making everyday services more accessible to local residents.
ex.zh: 街角商店让当地居民更方便地获得日常服务，从而鼓励人们步行。

col: around the corner｜在拐角处；即将到来
tip: 室内角落用in the corner；街道拐角常用on或at。

senses.en: free from mistakes and matching the facts
to identify mistakes or change something to make it right
suitable or accepted as proper for a particular situation

ex.en: You were correct about the keys being under the sofa.
ex.zh: 你说钥匙在沙发下面，果然没错。

ex.en: Teachers should help students correct their mistakes rather than simply provide them with the right answers.
ex.zh: 教师应帮助学生纠正错误，而不是仅仅给他们正确答案。

tip: 既是形容词也是动词；correctly才是副词。

senses.en: in a way that is accurate or follows the rules

ex.en: Check that you have entered your address correctly.
ex.zh: 检查一下，确保你的地址输入正确。

ex.en: Students need regular feedback to ensure that they apply newly learned scientific concepts correctly in practical situations.
ex.zh: 学生需要定期获得反馈，以确保他们能在实际情境中正确运用新学的科学概念。

col: if I remember correctly｜如果我没记错
tip: 修饰动作；correct是形容词或动词，不作副词使用。

senses.en: the money needed to buy or do something
to require a particular amount of money
something valuable lost to achieve or obtain something

ex.en: The cost of our weekly groceries keeps rising.
ex.zh: 我们每周购买食品杂货的费用不断上涨。

ex.en: Improving public transport can reduce the cost of commuting and make cities more accessible.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以降低通勤成本，并让城市出行更加便利。

col: the cost of living｜生活成本
at all costs｜不惜一切代价
tip: 表示花费时，过去式和过去分词均为cost。

senses.en: Force air suddenly from your throat with a rough sound.
The act or sound of coughing, or an illness causing it.

ex.en: The dusty room made me cough several times.
ex.zh: 房间里的灰尘让我咳嗽了好几次。

ex.en: People with a persistent cough should seek medical advice, particularly if symptoms interfere with sleep or daily activities.
ex.zh: 持续咳嗽的人应就医咨询，尤其是在症状影响睡眠或日常活动时。

tip: gh在此发/f/；have a cough表示有咳嗽症状。

senses.en: to find how many things there are
to matter or have an important effect
the act of counting, or the total found

ex.en: Please count the plates before our guests arrive.
ex.zh: 请在客人到来之前数一下盘子。

ex.en: When evaluating educational success, students' confidence and creativity should count as much as examination results.
ex.zh: 评估教育成效时，学生的自信和创造力应与考试成绩同样重要。

col: lose count｜数不清；忘记数到哪里
every minute counts｜每分钟都很重要
tip: count on意为依靠；count作“重要”时不及物。

senses.en: An area of land governed as an independent political unit.
Land outside towns and cities, often with farms and villages.
A popular music style rooted in rural American traditions.

ex.en: She hopes to visit another country next summer.
ex.zh: 她希望明年夏天去另一个国家旅行。

ex.en: Each country should develop energy policies that reflect its natural resources and long-term environmental goals.
ex.zh: 各国都应根据本国自然资源和长期环境目标制定能源政策。

col: live in the country｜住在乡下
tip: 表示“乡下”常用 the country，与国家义区分。

senses.en: land outside towns and cities, including fields, woods, and farms

ex.en: We spent the weekend cycling through the quiet countryside.
ex.zh: 我们周末在宁静的乡间骑车游玩。

ex.en: Reliable public transport in the countryside can improve access to employment and reduce rural residents' dependence on cars.
ex.zh: 乡村地区可靠的公共交通可以改善就业机会的可及性，并减少农村居民对汽车的依赖。

col: protect the countryside｜保护乡村环境
tip: 通常不可数，常说the countryside，不说a countryside。

senses.en: Two people who are married or in a romantic relationship.
Two things or people, or a small number of them.
To join two things or consider them together.

ex.en: The couple next door invited us over for dinner.
ex.zh: 隔壁那对夫妇邀请我们去吃晚饭。

ex.en: High housing costs, coupled with limited childcare, can discourage young couples from starting a family.
ex.zh: 高昂的住房成本加上有限的托育服务，可能使年轻夫妇不愿生育孩子。

col: a married couple｜一对已婚夫妇
tip: a couple of后接复数名词，可指两个或少数几个。

senses.en: Ability to face danger or difficulty despite feeling afraid.

ex.en: It took courage to admit my mistake in class.
ex.zh: 在课堂上承认自己的错误需要勇气。

ex.en: Young people need courage to challenge unfair practices, especially when their opinions differ from those of others.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要勇气来质疑不公平的做法，尤其是在自己的观点与他人不同时。

col: have the courage to do something｜有勇气做某事
tip: 通常不可数；做某事的勇气用courage to do。

senses.zh: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
senses.en: A child of your aunt or uncle

ex.en: My cousin taught me to ride a bicycle yesterday.
ex.zh: 我的表姐昨天教我骑自行车。

ex.en: Children who regularly spend time with their cousins may develop strong family bonds beyond their immediate household.
ex.zh: 经常与堂表兄弟姐妹相处的孩子，可能与小家庭之外的亲人建立深厚感情。

col: a distant cousin｜远房堂亲或表亲
a younger cousin｜年幼的堂表亲
tip: 不区分堂表、性别或长幼；需要时另加说明。

senses.en: To put something over a surface or object.
To include something, deal with it, or pay its cost.
An outer layer that protects or encloses something.

ex.en: Cover the bread with a cloth while it cools.
ex.zh: 面包冷却时，用一块布盖住它。

ex.en: University scholarships should cover living expenses as well as tuition fees for students from low-income families.
ex.zh: 大学奖学金应为低收入家庭的学生支付生活费和学费。

col: cover a topic｜涉及某个话题
tip: cover A with B表示用B盖住A；cover费用指足以支付。

senses.en: an adult female bovine, often kept for milk
to frighten someone into obeying or giving up resistance

ex.en: A brown cow stood quietly beside the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一头棕色母牛静静地站在农场门旁。

ex.en: Improving the diet of dairy cows can increase milk production while supporting animal health.
ex.zh: 改善奶牛的饮食可以在促进动物健康的同时提高产奶量。

col: be cowed into silence｜被吓得不敢出声
tip: cow指成年母牛；cattle统称牛，不能说a cattle。

senses.en: An activity involving skill in making things by hand
Make something carefully and skilfully
A boat, aircraft, or spacecraft

ex.en: My neighbour teaches the craft of weaving willow baskets.
ex.zh: 我的邻居教授用柳条编篮子的手艺。

ex.en: Traditional craft workshops can preserve cultural knowledge while creating employment opportunities in rural communities.
ex.zh: 传统手工艺作坊既能保存文化知识，也能为农村社区创造就业机会。

col: craft a proposal｜精心拟订提案
tip: 表示船或飞行器时，craft的单复数形式相同。

senses.en: very unreasonable, foolish, or strange
extremely enthusiastic about someone or something
extremely annoyed or upset

ex.en: It seems crazy to wear sandals in this snow.
ex.zh: 下着这样的雪还穿凉鞋，实在很不明智。

ex.en: Although some people consider car-free cities a crazy idea, such policies could significantly improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 尽管一些人认为无车城市是个荒唐的想法，这类政策却可能显著改善城市空气质量。

tip: 偏口语；crazy about表示着迷，不宜用来称呼精神疾病患者。

senses.en: The thick, fatty part of milk, used in food.
A thick substance applied to skin for protection or treatment.
Having a pale yellowish-white colour.

ex.en: She poured fresh cream over a bowl of strawberries.
ex.zh: 她把新鲜奶油浇在一碗草莓上。

ex.en: Replacing cream with lower-fat ingredients can reduce the energy content of meals without greatly affecting flavour.
ex.zh: 用低脂食材替代奶油，可以降低餐食的热量，而不会明显影响风味。

tip: cream是奶油或乳霜；cheese才是奶酪。

senses.en: to make something new or bring something into existence
to cause a situation, feeling, or problem to develop

ex.en: We created a colourful bird from folded paper.
ex.zh: 我们用折纸做出了一只色彩鲜艳的小鸟。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can create jobs while reducing dependence on imported fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源能创造就业机会，同时减少对进口化石燃料的依赖。

col: create a work of art｜创作艺术作品
tip: create强调创造新事物，也可接problem表示造成问题。

senses.en: the process of bringing something new into existence
something new that someone has made or designed

ex.en: The creation of our garden took several busy weekends.
ex.zh: 我们忙了好几个周末才建好花园。

ex.en: Investment in renewable energy can support job creation while helping countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 投资可再生能源可以促进就业，同时帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖。

col: the creation of wealth｜财富的创造
tip: 指创造过程通常不可数；指具体作品时可数。

senses.en: Able to produce original ideas, or involving imagination.

ex.en: My creative sister turned old jars into colourful lamps.
ex.zh: 我富有创意的姐姐把旧罐子变成了彩色灯具。

ex.en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
ex.zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。

col: a creative solution｜创新的解决方案
tip: 形容人有创意或方法新颖；名词形式是creativity。

senses.en: to go from one side to another, or intersect
a shape made by two intersecting lines, or a religious symbol
annoyed or slightly angry

ex.en: We waited for the traffic to stop before crossing.
ex.zh: 我们等车辆停下后才过马路。

ex.en: Safer pedestrian routes encourage residents to cross busy roads on foot rather than drive short distances.
ex.zh: 更安全的步行路线鼓励居民步行穿过繁忙道路，而不是短途开车。

tip: cross是动词；across是介词或副词。

senses.en: A large group of people gathered in one place.
To gather closely together or fill a place with people.

ex.en: A crowd gathered around the musicians in the square.
ex.zh: 一群人聚在广场上的乐手周围。

ex.en: Large crowds at popular attractions can damage historic sites unless visitor numbers are carefully managed.
ex.zh: 热门景点的大量游客可能破坏历史遗址，除非游客数量得到妥善管理。

tip: a crowd of后接复数名词；crowded表示拥挤的。

senses.en: Containing so many people or things that little space remains

ex.en: The bus was so crowded that we stood all the way.
ex.zh: 公交车太拥挤了，我们一路都站着。

ex.en: Crowded urban neighbourhoods need accessible parks where residents can exercise and enjoy some personal space.
ex.zh: 拥挤的城市社区需要方便到达的公园，让居民能够锻炼并享有一些个人空间。

tip: be crowded with 表示“挤满……”。

senses.en: The firm outer layer of bread or pastry.
The solid outer layer of the Earth.
A hard layer that forms on a surface.

ex.en: This fresh bread has a wonderfully crisp crust.
ex.zh: 这条新鲜面包的外皮特别酥脆。

ex.en: Movements within the Earth's crust can cause earthquakes that severely damage buildings and transport networks.
ex.zh: 地壳内部的运动可能引发地震，严重破坏建筑物和交通网络。

tip: 地壳用the Earth's crust；面包皮也用crust。

senses.en: Produce tears because of sadness, pain, or strong emotion.
Call out loudly because of strong emotion or urgent need.
A loud sound expressing emotion or attracting attention.

ex.en: The baby began to cry when her toy fell.
ex.zh: 玩具掉了，宝宝就哭了起来。

ex.en: Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.
ex.zh: 幼儿与父母分开时可能会哭，因此学校应营造亲切友好的环境。

col: have a good cry｜痛哭一场
tip: 过去式cried；现在分词crying；表示喊叫常用cry out。

senses.en: relating to volume measured in cubes, or shaped like a cube

ex.en: Our new water tank holds two cubic metres.
ex.zh: 我们的新水箱能容纳两立方米的水。

ex.en: Modern irrigation systems can save thousands of cubic metres of water each year.
ex.zh: 现代灌溉系统每年可以节约数千立方米的水。

tip: cubic用于体积单位；square用于面积单位。

senses.en: A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.

ex.en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
ex.zh: 她把一根黄瓜切成片，加入沙拉。

ex.en: Growing cucumbers in greenhouses can provide a reliable food supply, but heating these structures requires energy.
ex.zh: 在温室中种植黄瓜可以提供稳定的食物供应，但为这些设施供暖需要消耗能源。

col: as cool as a cucumber｜非常镇定
tip: 通常可数：a cucumber；表示食材时也可不可数。
